content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Owns and runs casinos with gaming revenue; no online lodging marketplace or host model."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Organizes B2B trade shows and exhibitions; different customers and earning model from a travel marketplace."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Two-sided marketplace, but for handmade and resale goods rather than travel stays or experiences."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants; a real estate landlord, not a travel platform."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Operates owned expedition ships and guided trips; asset-heavy tour operator, not a host marketplace."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells vacation ownership interests and runs resorts; timeshare sales and financing differ from booking marketplace fees."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Advertising and marketing agency serving brands; no travel booking or marketplace business."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings under long-term leases; a property landlord, not a travel business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Owns upscale hotels and earns room revenue directly; no online marketplace connecting hosts and guests."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Marketing and advertising agency network serving corporate brands; unrelated to travel bookings."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Owns one San Francisco hotel and apartment buildings; asset-owning landlord rather than booking platform."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Online travel platform earning booking commissions and fees on stays, tours and reservations, serving travelers and travel suppliers."}]}
